category_title: Students exhibiting explicit acts of misbehavior and physical aggression
minimal_context: The student is asked to describe vocabulary game cards in English during a language lesson.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's look at these vocabulary game cards. Please pick one and describe what you see in English.

STUDENT: (Gives a persistent inaudible response and shows an unwillingness to speak in the target language.)

TUTOR: I couldn't hear you. What do you think?

STUDENT: (Shows a lack of attention and motivation, struggling with difficulties expressing their ideas in English.) I don't know. I don't want to do this.

TUTOR: We need to finish this English activity. Please try.

STUDENT: (Exhibits feelings of boredom and frustration by putting their head down to sleep in class, then suddenly sits up and begins disruptive talking with a classmate instead of participating.)

options.A: Explicitly teach that speakers can use the same vocabulary differently, using student variations as an example.
options.B: Acknowledge the use of the game cards, then guide the student to separate and chunk the English word.
options.C: Ask the student the vocabulary word, prompting: 'This one, you know it, it's in your favorite game.'
options.D: Change the English activities frequently during the remainder of the language lesson.
